topIssues.pattern: Calls often end without recap, next steps, or alternate CTA.
Agent discusses times or collects data but does not confirm booking via book_appointment.
Homeowner status or service area skipped before scheduling.
Scarcity pressure used when caller wants to consult spouse.
Unsupported guarantees on savings, rebates, or warranty terms.
Caller requested manager; transfer_to_human not invoked.

executiveSummary: Across 12 calls, only 1 fully met the booking goal with proper qualification and close. The biggest systemic gaps are weak follow-up/closing, incomplete booking confirmation, and compliance drift on guarantees. Objection handling and escalation need prompt and guardrail updates.
